use_case_summary: Enterprise private VPC deployment for customer-facing support assistant and internal compliance tooling. Primary concerns: audit logging parity with internal SIEM, detailed access and admin logs, data residency guarantees, and customer-managed KMS for stored artifacts and log exports.
technical_requirements: SIEM export: support push to Splunk via HTTP Event Collector and syslog/CEF for legacy collectors; also S3 export for archival ingestion

Log schema: provide ECS-mapped fields + mapping doc. Must include: timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, model, model_version, route, prompt_hash, token_counts, latency_ms, response_flags (filtered, truncated), redaction_flags
Retention: 90d hot storage, then lifecycle to cold S3 Glacier; total retention configurable up to 7 years; SLA on export delivery <= 5min for hot-forwarding
Access logs: admin console audit (who changed routing/keys), API key usage, token-level billing traces, and per-user access control logs
KMS integration: customer-managed key (AWS KMS) for DB and S3 encryption, rotation policy support, ability to bring-your-own HSM-backed key
Delivery guarantees: ordered delivery for audit events, idempotency keys, retry/backoff, and DLQ to S3 for failed deliveries
PII controls: configurable PII redaction hooks pre-export, with signed attestations that raw PII is never stored unencrypted longer than X hours (configurable)
Network & auth: VPC peering, private endpoints, mTLS for log forwarder, allowlist IPs for Splunk HEC when used
Schema examples: request start/stop events, tokenization deltas, KV-cache miss/hit events for per-request cost attribution
